description_en: Manually renews a subscription ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 为包年包月RDS实例手动续费
name: RenewInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure idempotence. It is generated by the client, contains only ASCII characters, and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 幂等性令牌，由客户端生成（ASCII字符，最大长度64）
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. Unit: months. Valid values:
1 to 9 (consecutive integers)
12
24
36
48
60
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长，单位：月。取值：
1~9（连续整数）
12
24
36
48
60
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically pay for the renewal. Valid values:
True: Automatic payment. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
False (default): Manual payment in the console.

To manually renew the instance in the console, see:
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96050.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96741.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95637.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97122.html
parameters.help_zh:
续费时是否自动付费。取值：
True：自动付费。请确保账号有足够的余额。
False（默认）：控制台手动付费。

控制台手动续费，请参见：
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96050.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96741.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95637.html
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97122.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false (default): No
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，取值：

true：是。
false（默认）：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a voucher. Valid values:
true: Use a voucher.
false (default): Do not use a voucher
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券，取值：
true：使用代金券。
false（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
The voucher code.

This parameter is required when the AutoUseCoupon parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
代金券code。

AutoUseCoupon参数取值为true（使用代金券）时必填
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether compression is enabled for the instance
parameters.name: compression_mode
